file_format: one JSON object per line: id, set, split, prompt, answer, aliases, scorer, meta; sorted keys, separators (',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, '\n' line ends
name: ruler_vt_4k

prompt_adapter.answer_line: Answer: <the names of all the variables, separated by spaces>
prompt_adapter.description: RULER variable tracking (NVIDIA/RULER@c3f5e3b4): one randomized ICL example, noise haystack, 1 chain x 4 hops; answer prefix replaced by the shared answer line.
prompt_adapter.name: ruler_vt

sampling.method: generated; sample i uses random.Random(derive_int(seed, set, 'sample', i))

config.noise: The grass is green. The sky is blue. The sun is yellow. Here we go. There and back again.

split_rule.rule: 80% dev / 20% final; n_final = round_half_up(N/5), apportioned over strata by largest remainder; lowest sha256(seed|split|set|id) in each stratum go to final

tokenizer.counted: Qwen3 chat template, one user message, add_generation_prompt, enable_thinking=True
